nodes.name: StemGeometry
nodes.coreScript:
local segments = 12
local radius = 4
local height = 180

if not STEM_BUILT then
    local bottom = {}
    local top = {}
    for i = 0, segments - 1 do
        local angle = (i / segments) * 2 * math.pi
        local x = math.cos(angle) * radius
        local z = math.sin(angle) * radius
        bottom[i] = {x, 0, z}
        top[i] = {x, height, z}
    end

    for i = 0, segments - 1 do
        local ni = (i + 1) % segments
        local b0 = bottom[i]
        local b1 = bottom[ni]
        local t0 = top[i]
        local t1 = top[ni]

        local midAngle = ((i + 0.5) / segments) * 2 * math.pi
        local nx = math.cos(midAngle)
        local nz = math.sin(midAngle)
        local stemColour = {58, 122, 42, 255}

        addVertexes({
            Vertex{posn = b0, colour = stemColour, normal = {nx, 0, nz}},
            Vertex{posn = t0, colour = stemColour, normal = {nx, 0, nz}},
            Vertex{posn = b1, colour = stemColour, normal = {nx, 0, nz}},
            Vertex{posn = b1, colour = stemColour, normal = {nx, 0, nz}},
            Vertex{posn = t0, colour = stemColour, normal = {nx, 0, nz}},
            Vertex{posn = t1, colour = stemColour, normal = {nx, 0, nz}},
        })
    end

    STEM_BUILT = true
end

nodes.name: FlowerGeometry
nodes.coreScript:
local layers = 5
local petalsPerLayer = 6
local goldenAngle = 137.5 * math.pi / 180

if not FLOWER_BUILT then
    for layer = 0, layers - 1 do
        local layerRadius = 6 + layer * 9
        local petalLength = 22 + layer * 5
        local petalWidth = 10 + layer * 3
        local curl = 10 - layer * 1.5
        local layerRotation = layer * goldenAngle

        local red = math.max(120, 210 - layer * 15)
        local petalColour = {red, 20 + layer * 5, 55 + layer * 5, 255}

        for p = 0, petalsPerLayer - 1 do
            local angle = layerRotation + p * (2 * math.pi / petalsPerLayer)
            local cosA = math.cos(angle)
            local sinA = math.sin(angle)

            local function toWorld(lx, ly, lz)
                local rx = lx * cosA - lz * sinA
                local rz = lx * sinA + lz * cosA
                return {rx + cosA * layerRadius, ly, rz + sinA * layerRadius}
            end

            local baseLeft = toWorld(0, 0, -petalWidth / 2)
            local baseRight = toWorld(0, 0, petalWidth / 2)
            local tipLeft = toWorld(petalLength, curl, -petalWidth / 4)
            local tipRight = toWorld(petalLength, curl, petalWidth / 4)

            addVertexes({
                Vertex{posn = baseLeft, colour = petalColour},
                Vertex{posn = tipRight, colour = petalColour},
                Vertex{posn = baseRight, colour = petalColour},
                Vertex{posn = baseLeft, colour = petalColour},
                Vertex{posn = tipLeft, colour = petalColour},
                Vertex{posn = tipRight, colour = petalColour},
            })
        end
    end

    FLOWER_BUILT = true
end
